Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia puts Trump under new congressional scrutiny

Democrats were preparing to investigate the company. The president’s extraordinary role in restoring its CEO has expanded the inquiry.

November 24, 2026 at 5:00 a.m. EST17 minutes ago
6 min
By Faiz Siddiqui
and 
Pranshu Verma

President Donald Trump’s intervention to restore Jensen Huang as Nvidia’s chief executive has opened a new front in congressional investigations, putting both the president and the powerful tech executive in lawmakers’ sights.
